sentences.en: The separatists want to replace Islam altogether in our region.
sentences.zh: 分裂主义者想在我们地区彻底取代伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: My students are few in number, no more than five altogether.
sentences.zh: 我的学生人数不多，总共不超过五人。

sentences.en: Beauty is altogether in the eye of the beholder.
sentences.zh: 美完全在于观察者的眼中。
